verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It partitions binary strings with at least k+1 ones according to the position of the (k+1)-st one, yielding the stated summands, and then uses bitwise complementation to show that this set has cardinality half of all binary strings of length 2k+1, namely 4^k. All arguments apply for every nonnegative integer k, and there are no external references or prohibited justification patterns.
